not_yet_in_model_note: Identifiers are derived from hashed normalized financial mirrors and remain NOT_CERTIFIED. They must be reconciled against a dated official PIT issuer master before full coverage can be declared.
source_scope: ALL_TRACKED_ISSUERS; comparable research scenarios regardless of legacy primary cohort; source tiers disclosed; not certified investment returns
blocking_rules: Never mark PASS without issuer-specific source, publication time, financial period and document hash.
CB and financing events require effective conversion terms and actual outstanding balances.
Negative operating cash flow triggers working-capital and capex bridge, not automatic rejection.
Do not promote a candidate solely from modeled upside or reconstructed historical data.
Official full-universe certification requires an independently reconciled PIT issuer list.
